_comment_targets: Daily committed target in TONS per machine. Monthly target = daily x working_days_per_month. Machines listed here get a target; anything not listed (e.g. Outside job work) is reported without a target. The values below match the sample dataset, not any real plant.
_comment_loss: Plant-level acceptable loss (TOTAL SCRAP / SLITTING IN, as %). Used as the reference line on every loss chart.
_comment_scope: Machine groups for the global scope selector. Order here is the order shown in the sidebar; the first one is the default.
_comment_bands: Upper edges in mm for the RM width bands used in the Size & Loss analysis.
_comment_thickness: Upper edges in mm for the RM thickness bands.
_comment_guard: A machine/band cell is only allowed to generate a written insight if it has at least this many tons of input. Stops small samples from producing headline claims.
_comment_operators: Names that belong to outside job-work firms rather than in-house operators. Kept out of operator performance comparisons.
_comment_aliases: Spelling variants of the same person or firm, collapsed to one name. LEFT = as typed in Excel, RIGHT = canonical. The live plant file needs a much longer list than this.
_comment_tat: A job taking longer than this many days between Outward (sent to machine) and Inward (returned) is flagged for review.
_comment_massbal: Mass-balance tolerance in tons: |IN - (OUT + TRIM + SCRAP + EXCESS + SHOT)| above this is flagged.
